Names You Already Know

Parks & Recreation

Six Parks, Two Lakes

Conway Park is a half mile up the street — ball fields, a playground and the rec centre. Battle Creek adds wooded trails, a winter ski hill, a waterfall and an off-leash dog park. Indian Mounds sits on the bluff with the whole river valley below it, and Lake Phalen brings a swimming beach and a loop trail within eight minutes.

Wellness

From the Corner Gym to the Full Club

An Anytime Fitness sits two minutes away for the 6am habit, and the Conway Recreation Center is closer still. Further out the options widen: climbing walls at Vertical Endeavors, the Eastside YMCA pool, heated classes at CorePower, and Life Time in Woodbury with courts, pools and a spa under one roof.

Shopping & Groceries

Target at the End of the Block

Target is on Suburban Avenue, close enough to walk when the weather cooperates, with Cub Foods a minute further for the full grocery run. Point the car east instead and the Woodbury corridor opens up — Costco, Lunds & Byerlys, Whole Foods, Trader Joe’s, and the open-air shops at Woodbury Lakes.
